name: Strength
summary: Complete two focused sessions on non-consecutive training days, progressing the main lifts with reverse-pyramid sets.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.note: Reduce the load by roughly 10% after each set.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.note: Reduce the load by roughly 10% after each set.

exercises.name: Weighted Chin-up
exercises.note: Reduce the load by roughly 10% after each set.

exercises.name: Hang Clean or Sumo Deadlift
exercises.note: Choose one variation and keep it consistent.

methodNotes.definition: Reverse-pyramid training: begin with the heaviest set, then reduce load as reps increase.
Add load after completing the top of the prescribed rep range with clean form.

name: Full Body
summary: A five-day full-body progression organized into six blocks with exact sets, reps, rest periods, and repetitions in reserve.

methodNotes.definition: Repetitions in reserve: the estimated reps left before failure.
Follow the block sequence in order; later blocks adjust exercise selection, volume, and effort.

name: Physique
summary: A three-phase Monday, Wednesday, and Friday plan that moves from reverse-pyramid strength work into higher-density training.

methodNotes.definition: Reverse-pyramid training: start heavy, then reduce load as the target reps rise.
Complete an initial set, take a brief pause, then perform short mini-sets.
Use short rests to complete the prescribed work in less time while keeping form controlled.
Build load gradually while staying inside the assigned repetition range.

name: Push / Pull / Legs
summary: A six-day push, pull, and legs rotation across six progressive blocks, with an additional core session to place during the week.

methodNotes.definition: Repetitions in reserve: the estimated reps left before failure.
Place the core session at least once each week where recovery and scheduling allow.

name: Progressive Split
summary: Four progressive four-week blocks combining push, pull, legs, upper-body, and lower-body training with prescribed reps in reserve.
